full_page.content:
1934, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 180 Mar. 7th Mrs. Du. Kerr - 70 - Arthritis and blind - in agony with arthri- tis & anxious.
Luke Manion - 21 - sailor, curviture of spine a little, slight- ly paralysed.
Freda Fallow - 33 - Arthritis, convert - has husband and two sons depending on her.
Mrs. A. Resico - 68 - Eloise - had breast cut off last August. Now threatening again.
Mrs. Hoenaert - has husband & 5 (2+) sickly, told of a healer that help her, she went to the (lady) healer and has had a sad story since. Disagreement and suspicion in the family since, fears at times will lose mind.
Stella Szulczewski - 72 - lost home & property then daughter lost mind but recovered. Now in Providence Hospital.
Loretta Roach - 18 - companying with a decidedly undesirable person. ...
Anthony K. - 19 - ear trouble-once a year to communion.
Jewish - Redemptorist, brothers, priests - ... "are you hungry, Nora .. =
Mrs. Cath. Loeckner - 62 - heart, nerves.
Page 181 March
Joseph Bialk - 58 - A Hernia ... X - 49 - Italian 49 - totally blind
Alphonse Giradot - 30 - bad arthritis or even paralysis -
Mr. & Mrs. G. Fam .... to sell their property. Louis H. Kirschner of Columbus, O .... mental ...
Mrs. C. M. Evans - 36 - cancer of hip-bone and phlebitis - Drs. give no hope of possible recovery. Enrolled at 9:45.
Mrs. Teresa Hazel - 39 - fears serious operation - son 17 very unruly ... was enrolled & pray'd for .... Own mother could hardly be- lieve change. Deo Gratias! !!!
